responsibility: Provides the incremental-compilation test pass that checks codegen-unit work-product reuse expectations. When incremental mode is enabled, it reads crate-level `#[rustc_partition_reused]`, `#[rustc_partition_codegened]`, and `#[rustc_expected_cgu_reuse]` annotations, filters them by the requested `cfg`, maps the user-specified module path to an actual codegen unit name, verifies that the referenced CGU exists, and records the expected pre-LTO, post-LTO, or regenerated status with the session’s CGU reuse tracker so later compilation results can be validated against the test’s assertions.
